description_en:
Lightweight Application: Asynchronous Video Splitting Task\
To use the free video splitting feature, you must activate Media and Entertainment Video Understanding: https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend\
The video splitting feature supports video processing for the following three scenarios:\
1. Program scenario\
2. News scenario\
3. Other scenarios\
For more information, including detailed usage recommendations and sample prompts, see the Additional Information section below.\
\
\
\
\
\
description_zh:
轻应用-视频拆条异步任务

使用视频拆条需先开通影视传媒视频理解（免费开通）https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend

目前拆条提供三种场景视频的处理：
1、节目场景 2、新闻场景 3、其他场景
详细使用建议及参考prompt请查看下方补充说明
kebab_example: aliyun quanmiaolightapp submit-video-detect-shot-task --workspace-id llm-xxx --video-url https://xxx.mp4 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitVideoDetectShotTask

parameters.help_en: Unique identifier for the Model Studio workspace. https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
Large language model (LLM). We recommend deepseek-r1. Options:

deepseek-r1

quanmiao-llm-max

quanmiao-llm-max-thinking

quanmiao-llm-plus

quanmiao-llm-turbo
parameters.help_zh:
llm的模型，推荐选择deepseek-r1
可选项：
deepseek-r1
quanmiao-llm-max
quanmiao-llm-max-thinking
quanmiao-llm-plus
quanmiao-llm-turbo
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.help_en: Select how to perform shot detection. Options: ASR
parameters.help_zh: 用户选择使用什么方式进行分镜，可选项：ASR
parameters.name: options

parameters.help_en: Deduplication field. Define your unique business identifier as needed. For values that repeat in this field, the system prevents duplicate submissions for at least 72 hours
parameters.help_zh: 排重字段：可以根据业务需要和业务场景定义自己的业务唯一标识，当前字段重复的数据，系统会保证至少72h内不允许重复提交
parameters.name: deduplication_id

parameters.help_en: Unique identifier for the source task. To rerun a subtask (defined by the generateOptions field) based on a previous task, pass the previous task's taskId and originalSessionId. The backend loads the previous task's generated data, skips earlier steps, and improves efficiency. If the stored data is older than 7 days, the query fails and the system reruns dependent subtasks automatically
parameters.help_zh: 源任务唯一标识：如果要基于历史任务重跑某个子任务（generateOptions字段指定的），可以传入历史任务taskId+originalSessionId，后台会加载历史任务已生成数据，跳过前置步骤，提升生成效率，如果后台数据过久，比如超过7天，查询失败，会默认重跑前置依赖子任务
parameters.name: original_session_id

parameters.name: model_vl_custom_prompt_template_id

parameters.help_en: Select how to detect content for each shot. Options: ASR, OCR, VL. You can select multiple
parameters.help_zh: 用户选择使用什么方式对每个分镜进行内容识别，可选项：ASR，OCR，VL，可多选
